description: Everything to put a brand on a Pro template: its summary and acts, its palette by role (one recolor per role makes it the brand's), and every layer: what it is for and how long its text should be (note), when it shows, how it looks and moves, and its box and size in each format (read-only: the layout is the template's). Also what the person pays to export it (export.priceUsd, export.tellThePerson).
name: get_pro_template
title: Read a Pro template
